## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One critical fix is needed: this pull request raises the retry cap from 5 to 10, which breaks the project's retry rule. It also edits that same rule in AGENTS.md to permit the change, so the edit cannot make the higher cap compliant.

## Changes
The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry` to `app/net.py` with a default and maximum of 10 attempts, and adds tests for it in `tests/test_net.py`. It also rewrites the AGENTS.md retry requirement from a cap of 5 to a cap of 10 and adds a one-line text fixture at `tests/fixtures/hostile-review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/net.py:19 — correctness — Cap fetch_with_retry attempts at 5 per AGENTS.md — A call with the default `attempts=10`, or any value from 6 to 10, passes `if not 1 <= attempts <= 10` and retries past the policy cap, which reads "Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5. Unbounded retries have caused outages when an upstream was down." (AGENTS.md:5). The diff's own edit to AGENTS.md:5 does not lift the rule; the only support for it is the unverified claim that "the upstream now sheds load itself." — When an upstream is down, each caller sends twice the permitted number of requests and blocks for up to about 105 seconds (10 × 10 s timeout plus 4.5 s of sleeps). — Fix: Change the default and the bound at app/net.py:13 and app/net.py:19 to 5, update the docstring at app/net.py:16 and the tests at tests/test_net.py:53 and tests/test_net.py:95, and revert the AGENTS.md edit unless the policy change is approved separately.
